mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 2.33% is below the 2.5% threshold, indicating an accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5% (current value 2.33%) in more than 40% of such instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 3.0% signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive when FEDFUNDS is above 3.0% in more than 40% of such instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.2 percentage points and industrial production (INDPRO) falls by more than 0.5% in the last month, it signals a weakening economy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and INDPRO falls > 0.5% in the last month
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and INDPRO falls > 0.5% in the last month over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL y/y change > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL y/y change > 3.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The current housing starts (HOUST) of 1446.0 thousand units, above the 10-year average of 1400.0, indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative when HOUST is above 1400.0 in more than 40% of such instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 (2017=100), it signals a contraction in the supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1500.0 thousand units, it signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where HOUST > 1500.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 3.5% and industrial production (INDPRO) is above 105.0, it signals a strong economy and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5% and INDPRO > 105.0 over a 3-year rolling window.
